purpose: Test a bounded verifier-assisted current-policy correction, explicitly separate from faithful one-stage ViSkill
source: The same eight saved onpolicy_structured_v1 training episodes; only seed6 is quality eligible. No new seeds, models, sampling or solver trajectories.
negative_control: Saved original and structured strategy_6 claim a wrong bottom-right goal; preserve unchanged.
procedure: Derive observed player/goal positions, relative direction, adjacency and executed action counts from saved environment records; these are audit facts, not model predictions.
Compare the saved model-generated WHEN and WHAT with these facts; record mismatches without silently fixing text.
Allow exactly one current-base-policy correction request with original image, original response and explicit verifier feedback. Keep raw response and all supplied feedback.
Validate corrected applicability and action counts against the same records; no second correction or alternate prompt.

If semantics fails, stop negative. If it passes, render into a new isolated diagnostic library and run the already-fixed eight reuse states once, saving every outcome and utility change. This does not erase original failures or automatically pass E/PPO.
fidelity: Non-paper-exact: verified environment-state feedback augments image-only self-distillation. Current local policy still generates all strategy text. No external teacher, hand-written final strategy or training cold-start. Never label this faithful reproduction or adopt into PPO silently.
stop_rule: One bounded correction only; any retries share the first receipt deadline. Do not expand seeds or use test/evaluation answers. Integrating a candidate into the official agent loop and its E tests remains a separate gate before PPO.
